name: Mother's Day Workshop
description: Join a free, creative workshop for kids aged 3-6 to make something special for Mother's Day. A session for older children (7-13) is also available on Thursday.
longDescription:
This Mother's Day Workshop, hosted by English Naturally, offers children an opportunity to create a handmade gift for their mothers. The workshop is designed to foster creativity and provide a meaningful activity for young participants in celebration of Mother's Day.

The session on May 8th is tailored for children aged 3 to 6, providing a supervised environment for craft activities. A separate session for children aged 7 to 13 is scheduled for Thursday, May 7th. The workshop is conducted in English, reflecting the venue's focus on language learning.

Participation in the workshop is free of charge. English Naturally is located in Porto, within walking distance of Trindade metro station.
